part_number.note: 16-digit MOT string. No dedicated SEL-2440 DPAC ordering-information document exists in the corpus (WI-11970 is for the Axion 2245 analog module), so this block is derived from the master configurable drawing i7179b (drawing layer option groups), the SEL-2440 DPAC Data Sheet, and two real PARTNO values embedded in the Instruction Manual (24402H11A1A11640, 24402H12B6314840). Drawing-layer option groups: MOUNTING (layer records digit 7), IO_OPTIONS (digit 8, length 4), SERIAL_PORT_2 (digit 12), ETHERNET_CONNECTION (digit 14). The two real part numbers place the mounting code (H = rack) at digit 6, not digit 7, so mounting is decoded at digit 6 here. Digits 5, 7, 13, 15, 16 are fixed or undocumented in the available references.
references: SEL-2440 master configurable drawing i7179b (drawing layers)
SEL-2440 DPAC Instruction Manual (2440_IM_20250414) — example part numbers

example_part_numbers.note: Real PARTNO from an SEL-2440 CID in the Instruction Manual: rack mount; I/O 1-1- = (32) DI + (16) DO at 125 Vdc/Vac (digit 9 = A); Port 2 EIA-232; (2) 10/100Base-T copper Ethernet.

Real PARTNO from an SEL-2440 RDB in the Instruction Manual: rack mount; I/O 2-63 = (32) DI + (10) fast high-current DO at 24 Vdc/Vac (digit 9 = B); Port 2 EIA-232; (2) 100Base-FX LC multimode fiber Ethernet.

positions.label: I/O configuration | Digital input voltage
positions.source: SEL-2440 master configurable drawing i7179b (drawing layers)+IM example part numbers
positions.note: 4-digit I/O field. Digit 8 = discrete-input group, digit 9 = digital input voltage, digits 10-11 = output configuration. Authoritative combined configurations from the drawing IO_OPTIONS layer (dash = digital-input-voltage wildcard): 2-1- = (48) DI; 1-1- = (32) DI + (16) DO; 1-6X = (16) DI + (32) DO; 1-61 = (16) HCI DI + (32) DO; 1-62 = (16) DI + (16) DO + (10) FHCDO; 2-63 = (32) DI + (10) FHCDO. Data sheet I/O quantity options: Standard 32 in/16 out, Option 1 16/32, Option 2 48/0, Option 3 16/32 (16 std + 16 HCI), Option 4 16/26, Option 5 32/10 fast high-current.

options.1-: (16) DO, or DI-only (no outputs) for the 48 DI configuration
